qualification: local A05.3 reliability investigation; not A05.3 closure, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.scope: Append ten stable context words for incoming Darwin x19 through x28, combine them with the existing FP/LR words, and make both memory-capable baseline blocks and all tier-one blocks restore the complete x19 through x30 bank from context storage instead of generated stack memory. Direct mixed-compiler chaining remained disabled.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Contain the positively observed x20 corruption and the earlier FP/LR corruption by removing the complete Darwin callee-saved bank from generated-frame authority.
candidate.regressionCoverage: Twenty-eight focused ABI, helper, chain, and metadata tests passed. A new real MAP_JIT regression overwrote every qword of a live tier-one scratch frame before exit and still returned cleanly with the context-backed host bank. The deterministic aggregate passed 1,556 tests in 179 suites.
candidate.productionFinding: The candidate prevented a host return crash but did not preserve guest correctness. Early kernel console strings contained repeated NUL insertion and duplicated fragments, /init never emitted its authenticated receipt, and the guest exhausted one billion instructions while cycling through page-table, spin-lock, scheduler-clock paths. The broader host save bank therefore does not repair the underlying layout-sensitive generated-execution defect.

verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,556 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled.
verification.secondAttemptSkipped: The complete one-billion-instruction run produced deterministic guest-visible corruption and no authenticated receipt; a second run cannot turn a correctness failure into acceptance.

consoleCorruption: Tasks RCU trampoline line contains six embedded NUL bytes and a duplicated suffix
PCI ECAM domain line contains six embedded NUL bytes and duplicated text
X.509 asymmetric-key parser line contains six embedded NUL bytes and a duplicated suffix

retainedBaseline.reason: The behavior-neutral coarse instrumentation remains the last production-safe measurement.

disposition.reason: The candidate is fully reverted. Context-backing the complete callee-saved bank contains the observed host return corruption but neither prevents nor explains the correlated guest-memory corruption. Future work must isolate the first generated write or state divergence with binary-layout-neutral tracing rather than expand the in-process context again.

limitations: The diagnostic samples only completed 1,000-instruction quanta and does not identify the first corrupting guest instruction.
The failure run's 46.22-percent avoidance is rejected correctness data and is not comparable performance evidence.
The experiment changed emitted block boundaries and the execution-context allocation size; it does not distinguish which layout change exposed the latent defect.
